# Performance

ComparaGeneTreeAlignment.Load reads the whole alignment file once, checking every row, and is the cost; mapping a query afterwards is a binary search. For human, mouse and rat at release 116 (64,114 proteins kept from 54,308 alignments), mzLib \#1465 reports about 33 s to load, and this bridge measured 55 s for the whole call on 2026-10-28, reading the three GTFs, the gene-tree file and the alignment. Give all of a batch's queries to one call. Neither load takes a degree of parallelism, so there is no --threads.

# References

- [doi:10.1101/gr.073585.107](https://doi.org/10.1101/gr.073585.107): Ensembl Compara gene trees, each built on a multiple alignment of its member proteins, the alignment this verb reads columns from (Vilella et al. 2009, Genome Res 19:327)
- [doi:10.1093/nar/gkaf1239](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaf1239): Ensembl releases, their GTFs and the Compara gene-tree files (Ensembl 2026, NAR)

# Not yet verified

The spec lists these as open; they are reported, never hidden:

- The outcome is mzLib's ComparaColumnOutcome name verbatim (Aligned, GapInTarget, ...), as classify-peptides projects PeptideSharing. genes orthology's statuses are snake\_case because mzLib names them (OrthologySnapshot.StatusName). PUSH-TO-MAINLAND: a ComparaGeneTreeAlignment.OutcomeName helper in the same style; when it lands the wire names change to its spelling, a breaking change to call out.
- MapResidue throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException for a position outside the source, which fails a whole batch. PUSH-TO-MAINLAND: a non-throwing outcome (PositionOutsideSource) so one bad query is one row. Until then the bridge projects the throw and does not check lengths itself.
- mzLib compares no release between the alignment and the gene-tree content (OrthologySnapshot.Build does, for the dumps). PUSH-TO-MAINLAND: ComparaGeneTreeAlignment.Load could refuse a gene-tree content named for another release, as Build refuses one; the bridge only reports it as a caveat.
- result.tables (alignment, gene\_trees, gene\_sets, proteins) is not validated by tools/check\_verbs.py, which checks only envelope\_fields, columns and bulk. Bridge tests pin each nested object's keys (GenesMapResiduesTests).
- Not yet ported to mzLibRust or mzLibR; the binding names above are proposals.
